description: Providing job opportunities in the Government sector for sportspersons who excel at National Level
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-06 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Although Sri Lanka has produced many sportspersons with exceptional abilities and achievements at the national and international levels, there is a tendency for them to retire prematurely from their sports careers due to the lack of stable employment opportunities. Further, this situation has also negatively affected Sri Lanka's capability in retaining the talents of the relevant sportspersons, maintaining high performance and international competitiveness. The number of permanent employment opportunities available for sportspersons in the Tri-Forces is also not sufficient, and it has been identified that the number of permanent employment opportunities in the field of sports available in the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and its affiliated institutions is also limited. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports to formulate an appropriate policy framework to provide employment opportunities in Government, Semi-Government and Statutory Institutions through a transparent, fair and merit-based selection process, so as to ensure the long-term employment security of sportspersons, with the aim of retaining high-performing sportspersons in the national sports system and encouraging them to achieve international achievements, was approved by the Cabinet.
